steps.content: Led by Samuel, the two carefully avoid battles and the mechanisms and reach the rendezvous point indicated by Donald's signal, a hidden dead end in the maze.
Samuel shoots a second signal as a response, also conveying the location to Donald's ally and contact person.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Next... just wait here. Your Chief will be fine.
Samuel gazes at the other end of the maze. The clamor of battle from Donald's side has stopped, which means the planned operation has ended and the FAC should have achieved their goal.

But the contamination hasn't subsided, and the Hypercube lantern in his hand keeps flickering. Samuel admits he's a coward, and now, his cowardly instinct is warning him. Unexpected danger is quietly approaching.

He takes out a small box and places it at the only opening of the dead end, leading Hecate to retreat two steps. The box automatically opens, revealing a few strands of red smoke. This is a sorcery that allows you to conceal yourself with Mania.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...This is Underground sorcery. Are you related to them? What those Mania fanatics did to Chief...

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: This is just a tool to hide your presence with Mania. We've obtained the Underground's tools and are using them to protect ourselves from Paradeisos and the Underground.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: I'm not your enemy. I won't hurt you or the people you care about.
Hecate takes a step back. Suspicion rises within her, but her rationality reminds her that his words do make sense.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's true... This kind of camouflage sorcery is also present around the refugee camp... They use it to protect Hella too.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Calm down, Hecate.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Does it make sense? Can I really trust this man? That female Executive Officer, and the people in the refugee camp too... They all want me to believe them...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But Rustfire wanted us to trust them too... Could these people... be planning to betray Chief as well?
Samuel reaches out to check her M-value, though the black mist emitted by the girl's body is already visible.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ...The contamination is worsening, contrary to what we expected. You're being affected by the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm being affected... Is that true? All these feelings I'm having... are caused by Mania?
Suspicion and anxiety surge wildly within her, causing Hecate's stomach to twist in pain, making her nauseous.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: The FAC couldn't control the Mania, so the contamination is intensifying. Perhaps due to the shackles, this Black Ring's influence on you is particularly significant. It's too dangerous to stay here. I'll take you back first.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No! I have to find Chief. I can control myself, I can do it.
Looking at her with concern, Samuel wants to say something but suddenly notices a weird sensation. He quickly pulls Hecate into the corner, hiding behind the camouflage sorcery.

At the other end of the maze, a foreboding presence is surging. Black mist rises out of nowhere and keeps spreading. The walls of the maze are slowly corroded into gel-like contamination, pulsating and taking on more familiar forms...

Corruptors. The cloaks, the red eyes, the Rustfire symbol, and... the black spikes protruding from their bodies. They are the "Rustfire Sinners" who went on a rampage after inheriting the shackles following ${PlayerName}'s death. Those who turned into Corruptors after the Black Ring outbreak. They've all ended up here.

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: Hehe... Our fires... will rage... Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Rustfire...
Hecate's breathing is turning shallow. Behind her, Nightmare begins swelling, a sign that she's unconsciously entering attack mode.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Calm down. We're not here to fight. Let them go.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Just avoid them. We're here waiting for the person who can save your Chief. Don't forget your goal.

The old man holds her back and gives her a sedative shot in time, retreating behind the cover of the sorcery. Corruptors attack humans instinctively, and the Underground sorcery can protect them from being discovered, as long as she doesn't expose herself.
Hecate tries hard to control herself, but the emotions and memories inside her are gradually spiraling out of control.

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: Syndicate belongs to us...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Hahaha, so this is the power of the Sinners! How extraordinary! I can still feel it gushing out on the other end! I'm so excited, I can't wait!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: With these shackles, all we have to do is to touch ${PlayerName}! If only we knew it was this simple! Why didn't ${PlayerName} give us this power earlier?
[Injured Hella CG]

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Cough, cough!!
Present and past intertwine momentarily. Under the illumination of the Black Ring, Hecate feels dizzy and vomits.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Breathe, Hecate, take a deep breath!

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Get those thoughts out of your head. You're resonating with the Black Ring. It's corroding your hatred and trying to control you in turn!

No matter how hard she tries to control herself, it's futile. Black contamination slowly leaks out of the girl's body. As if noticing their kind, those Corruptors suddenly turn around, see through the sorcery, and spot the hidden humans.

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: Intruders... from DisCity... Kill them!
The nightmares haunting her nights overlap with reality. She sees the shackles being defiled and abused, Hella covered in wounds, and her powerless self.

The black spikes slowly grow. The Black Ring reflected in Hecate's eyes gradually expands. Nightmare continues to swell. Without the restraint of the shackles, her willpower is so insignificant under the Black Ring. The Mania inside Hecate is being ignited.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Unforgivable... Those who hurt Chief and Hella are... unforgivable...
